crossRefs.note: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

people.name: Eshton
people.line: Son of Mehir; father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah.

people.name: Shuhah
people.line: Brother of Chelub, descendant of Judah.

translations.web: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

translations.kjv: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
